title: Chapli Kabab (Spicy Ground Beef Patties)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: The author's recreation, after many experiments, of the kababs he ate as a teenager in Ghari Habibullah, a village on the way to the Kaghan Valley known for nothing else. Soft butter in the mix stands in for the sheep fat used in northwest Pakistan.

steps.action: Knead together thoroughly by hand in a large bowl:
items: 4 Tbsp dried pomegranate seeds (or 2 Tbsp pomegranate powder)
3 Tbsp unsalted butter, very soft but not melted, in ⅓ in (1 cm) pieces
5 medium garlic cloves, very finely chopped (or 1 Tbsp garlic paste)
2 cu in ginger (2 × 3 × 5 cm), finely chopped (or 2 Tbsp ginger paste)

steps.action: Fold in gently, just to distribute:
items: 1 large firm tomato (8 oz / 225 g), in ⅓ in (1 cm) dice
6 green chilies (or 2 jalapeños), in thin rings, with seeds
1 cup loosely packed cilantro, roughly chopped, stems included

steps.action: Shape: split into quarters, then 3 patties per quarter, about ½ in (1.5 cm) thick.
Heat in a large frying pan over high, 2 min:
Fry in batches (about 3 at a time) on high, 3 min per side:
items: Nudge patties now and then so they don't stick
Flip in the order they went in

edits: Serving pairing taken from the Khichri headnote (good with kababs)
